out.note: Feed by cup (NG tube only if taking < 80% of feeds). Continue breastfeeding on demand. Do not aim for weight gain in Phase 1. Move to transition when appetite returns and edema is subsiding.
out.src: Ethiopian SAM guideline (2019); WHO management of severe acute malnutrition

rows: Same volume as Phase 1 F-75: 130 mL/kg/day
out.note: Edema +++ should be clearly subsiding before transition. Transition typically lasts 1–3 days: energy rises ≈ 30% at unchanged volume. Watch for fluid overload and refeeding problems (↑RR, ↑HR).
out.src: Ethiopian SAM guideline (2019); WHO management of severe acute malnutrition

rows: Small amounts across all 5 feeds, with safe water

alvarado.desc: Scores the MANTRELS criteria to estimate the probability of acute appendicitis and guide observation, imaging or surgical consultation.
alvarado.about: Scores the MANTRELS criteria to estimate the probability of acute appendicitis and guide observation, imaging or surgical consultation.

fields.label: Migration of pain to the right lower quadrant
Tenderness in the right lower quadrant

anc.name: Absolute Neutrophil Count
anc.desc: Calculates the absolute neutrophil count from the WBC and differential and grades neutropenia by CTCAE, flagging febrile-neutropenia risk.
anc.src: ANC = WBC × (neutrophils% + bands%) ⁄ 100; CTCAE v5 grades
anc.about: Calculates the absolute neutrophil count from the WBC and differential and grades neutropenia by CTCAE, flagging febrile-neutropenia risk.

anthro.name: Anthropometry & SAM Classifier
anthro.desc: Ethiopian SAM anthropometry calculator: WHO z-scores (weight-for-height/length, weight-for-age, height-for-age) with MUAC and edema grading, classifying SAM or MAM per the national guideline — age can be entered in months or from an Ethiopian-calendar date of birth.
anthro.src: Ethiopian National Guideline for Management of Acute Malnutrition (2019); WHO Child Growth Standards 2006
anthro.about: Ethiopian SAM anthropometry calculator: WHO z-scores (weight-for-height/length, weight-for-age, height-for-age) with MUAC and edema grading, classifying SAM or MAM per the national guideline — age can be entered in months or from an Ethiopian-calendar date of birth.

fields.label: Date of birth (optional — used if age not entered)

apgar.name: APGAR Score
apgar.desc: Scores newborn appearance, pulse, grimace, activity and respiration at 1 and 5 minutes to standardize immediate newborn assessment.
apgar.about: Scores newborn appearance, pulse, grimace, activity and respiration at 1 and 5 minutes to standardize immediate newborn assessment.

appetite.name: RUTF Appetite Test
appetite.desc: Shows the minimum RUTF amount a child must eat to pass the appetite test and routes passed or failed results to outpatient (OTP) or inpatient care.
appetite.src: Ethiopian National Guideline for Management of Acute Malnutrition (2019) — CMAM appetite test
appetite.about: Shows the minimum RUTF amount a child must eat to pass the appetite test and routes passed or failed results to outpatient (OTP) or inpatient care.

fields.label: Result of the test
opts: Not done yet — show the minimum amount
PASSED — ate at least the minimum amount
FAILED — ate less than the minimum amount

asa.name: ASA Physical Status
asa.desc: Assigns the ASA physical status classification with full definitions and the emergency modifier. A universal shorthand for communicating preoperative risk.
asa.src: ASA Physical Status Classification System (2020 update)
asa.about: Assigns the ASA physical status classification with full definitions and the emergency modifier. A universal shorthand for communicating preoperative risk.

fields.label: Classification
opts: ASA IV — severe systemic disease that is a constant threat to life
ASA V — moribund, not expected to survive without the operation
ASA VI — declared brain-dead, organ donor

ascvd.name: ASCVD Risk (Pooled Cohort)
ascvd.desc: Estimates 10-year atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease risk with the 2013 Pooled Cohort Equations for ages 40–79, categorizing risk to support statin decisions.
ascvd.src: Goff DC et al., 2013 ACC/AHA Pooled Cohort Equations
ascvd.about: Estimates 10-year atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease risk with the 2013 Pooled Cohort Equations for ages 40–79, categorizing risk to support statin decisions.

bishop.name: Bishop Score
bishop.desc: Scores cervical dilation, effacement, station, consistency and position to judge how favorable the cervix is for labour induction.
bishop.about: Scores cervical dilation, effacement, station, consistency and position to judge how favorable the cervix is for labour induction.

bmi.name: BMI Calculator
bmi.desc: Calculates body mass index from weight and height and classifies the result using WHO categories, from underweight to obesity class III. Useful for quick nutritional and metabolic risk screening in adults.
bmi.about: Calculates body mass index from weight and height and classifies the result using WHO categories, from underweight to obesity class III. Useful for quick nutritional and metabolic risk screening in adults.

bmr.name: Basal Metabolic Rate
bmr.desc: Estimates resting energy expenditure with the Mifflin–St Jeor equation. A practical starting point for nutrition planning and calorie targets.
bmr.src: Mifflin MD et al., Am J Clin Nutr 1990
bmr.about: Estimates resting energy expenditure with the Mifflin–St Jeor equation. A practical starting point for nutrition planning and calorie targets.

bpclass.name: BP Classification
bpclass.desc: Classifies a blood pressure reading into ACC/AHA 2017 categories, from normal through hypertensive crisis.
bpclass.src: Whelton PK et al., 2017 ACC/AHA hypertension guideline
bpclass.about: Classifies a blood pressure reading into ACC/AHA 2017 categories, from normal through hypertensive crisis.

bsa.name: Body Surface Area
bsa.desc: Calculates body surface area with the Mosteller formula from height and weight. Used for chemotherapy dosing, burn assessment and physiologic indices.
bsa.about: Calculates body surface area with the Mosteller formula from height and weight. Used for chemotherapy dosing, burn assessment and physiologic indices.

calvert.name: Carboplatin Dose (Calvert)
calvert.desc: Calculates the carboplatin dose from target AUC and GFR with the Calvert formula, applying the standard GFR cap of 125 mL/min.
calvert.src: Calvert AH et al., J Clin Oncol 1989
calvert.about: Calculates the carboplatin dose from target AUC and GFR with the Calvert formula, applying the standard GFR cap of 125 mL/min.

caprini.name: Caprini VTE Risk Score
caprini.desc: Totals the Caprini risk checklist to stratify surgical venous thromboembolism risk and suggests a prophylaxis tier per CHEST guidance.
caprini.src: Caprini JA, 2005 model; tiers per CHEST 2012 guidance
caprini.about: Totals the Caprini risk checklist to stratify surgical venous thromboembolism risk and suggests a prophylaxis tier per CHEST guidance.

fields.label: Serious lung disease incl. pneumonia (< 1 month)
History of unexplained or recurrent pregnancy loss
Medical patient currently at bed rest
Hip, pelvis or leg fracture (< 1 month)
Acute spinal cord injury / paralysis (< 1 month)

cca.name: Corrected Calcium
cca.desc: Adjusts total serum calcium for a low albumin level. Helps decide whether apparent hypo- or hypercalcemia is real before further work-up.
cca.about: Adjusts total serum calcium for a low albumin level. Helps decide whether apparent hypo- or hypercalcemia is real before further work-up.

chadsvasc.name: CHA₂DS₂-VASc Score
chadsvasc.desc: Scores annual stroke risk in non-valvular atrial fibrillation and maps guideline anticoagulation recommendations to the result.
chadsvasc.src: Lip GY et al., Chest 2010; annual rates per Friberg 2012
chadsvasc.about: Scores annual stroke risk in non-valvular atrial fibrillation and maps guideline anticoagulation recommendations to the result.

chemodose.name: Chemo Dose by BSA
chemodose.desc: Converts a protocol dose in mg/m² into an absolute chemotherapy dose using Mosteller body surface area. Verify against protocol rounding rules and dose caps.
chemodose.src: Mosteller BSA; dose = BSA × prescribed mg/m²
chemodose.about: Converts a protocol dose in mg/m² into an absolute chemotherapy dose using Mosteller body surface area. Verify against protocol rounding rules and dose caps.

cna.name: Corrected Sodium
cna.desc: Corrects the measured sodium for hyperglycemia to reveal true sodium status in hyperglycemic emergencies such as DKA and HHS.
cna.src: Katz MA, NEJM 1973 (1.6 mEq per 100 mg/dL glucose)
cna.about: Corrects the measured sodium for hyperglycemia to reveal true sodium status in hyperglycemic emergencies such as DKA and HHS.

crcl.name: Creatinine Clearance
crcl.desc: Estimates creatinine clearance with the Cockcroft–Gault equation from age, sex, weight and serum creatinine. Widely used for renal drug dosing.
crcl.about: Estimates creatinine clearance with the Cockcroft–Gault equation from age, sex, weight and serum creatinine. Widely used for renal drug dosing.

curb65.name: CURB-65
curb65.desc: Grades community-acquired pneumonia severity to guide outpatient care, hospital admission or ICU assessment.
curb65.about: Grades community-acquired pneumonia severity to guide outpatient care, hospital admission or ICU assessment.

ecog.name: ECOG Performance Status
ecog.desc: Records ECOG/WHO performance status with Karnofsky equivalents. A core determinant of fitness for systemic therapy and clinical-trial eligibility.
ecog.src: Oken MM et al., Am J Clin Oncol 1982
ecog.about: Records ECOG/WHO performance status with Karnofsky equivalents. A core determinant of fitness for systemic therapy and clinical-trial eligibility.

fields.label: Grade
opts: 1 — Restricted in strenuous activity; ambulatory, light work possible
2 — Ambulatory, capable of self-care; up > 50% of waking hours; no work
3 — Limited self-care; confined to bed/chair > 50% of waking hours
4 — Completely disabled; no self-care; totally confined to bed/chair

edd.name: Estimated Due Date
edd.desc: Ethiopian pregnancy due date calculator: estimates the delivery date from the last menstrual period (with cycle adjustment) or conception date, accepting Ethiopian calendar (ዓ.ም.) or Gregorian dates and showing the result in both calendars.
edd.about: Ethiopian pregnancy due date calculator: estimates the delivery date from the last menstrual period (with cycle adjustment) or conception date, accepting Ethiopian calendar (ዓ.ም.) or Gregorian dates and showing the result in both calendars.

egfr.name: eGFR (CKD-EPI 2021)
egfr.desc: Estimates glomerular filtration rate with the race-free CKD-EPI 2021 creatinine equation and assigns the KDIGO CKD stage. Central to detecting and monitoring kidney disease.
egfr.src: CKD-EPI 2021 (Inker LA et al., NEJM 2021); KDIGO stages
egfr.about: Estimates glomerular filtration rate with the race-free CKD-EPI 2021 creatinine equation and assigns the KDIGO CKD stage. Central to detecting and monitoring kidney disease.

f75f100.name: F-75 / F-100 / RUTF Schedule Engine
f75f100.desc: Generates exact daily and per-feed F-75, F-100 or RUTF requirements from weight, phase of SAM management (stabilization, transition, rehabilitation or OTP) and feed frequency, per the Ethiopian SAM guideline.
f75f100.src: Ethiopian SAM guideline (2019); WHO management of severe acute malnutrition
f75f100.about: Generates exact daily and per-feed F-75, F-100 or RUTF requirements from weight, phase of SAM management (stabilization, transition, rehabilitation or OTP) and feed frequency, per the Ethiopian SAM guideline.

fena.name: FENa
fena.desc: Calculates fractional excretion of sodium to help distinguish prerenal azotemia from intrinsic renal injury in acute kidney injury.
fena.about: Calculates fractional excretion of sodium to help distinguish prerenal azotemia from intrinsic renal injury in acute kidney injury.

fundal.name: Fundal Height Check
fundal.desc: Compares symphysis–fundal height with gestational age using the ±3 cm rule to screen for growth abnormalities and dating errors after 20 weeks.
fundal.src: SFH in cm ≈ GA in weeks (±3 cm), 20–36 weeks
fundal.about: Compares symphysis–fundal height with gestational age using the ±3 cm rule to screen for growth abnormalities and dating errors after 20 weeks.

ga.name: Gestational Age Calculator
ga.desc: Determines gestational age in weeks and days, trimester and term category from an LMP or known due date entered in the Ethiopian (ዓ.ም.) or Gregorian calendar.
ga.about: Determines gestational age in weeks and days, trimester and term category from an LMP or known due date entered in the Ethiopian (ዓ.ም.) or Gregorian calendar.

gcs.name: Glasgow Coma Scale
gcs.desc: Scores eye, verbal and motor responses to grade level of consciousness, with intubated (\u201cT\u201d) handling and severity bands for head injury.
gcs.about: Scores eye, verbal and motor responses to grade level of consciousness, with intubated (\u201cT\u201d) handling and severity bands for head injury.

gtpal.name: GTPAL Obstetric History
gtpal.desc: Formats and validates the obstetric history in GTPAL notation for clear, unambiguous documentation.
gtpal.about: Formats and validates the obstetric history in GTPAL notation for clear, unambiguous documentation.

hasbled.name: HAS-BLED Score
hasbled.desc: Scores major bleeding risk on anticoagulation to highlight modifiable risk factors — a prompt for risk reduction, not by itself a reason to withhold treatment.
hasbled.about: Scores major bleeding risk on anticoagulation to highlight modifiable risk factors — a prompt for risk reduction, not by itself a reason to withhold treatment.

fields.label: Abnormal renal function (dialysis, transplant, Cr > 2.26 mg/dL)
Abnormal liver function (cirrhosis, bilirubin > 2×, AST/ALT > 3× normal)

hba1c.name: HbA1c ↔ Average Glucose
hba1c.desc: Converts HbA1c to estimated average glucose and maps the result to ADA diagnostic categories.
hba1c.src: Nathan DM et al. (ADAG), Diabetes Care 2008
hba1c.about: Converts HbA1c to estimated average glucose and maps the result to ADA diagnostic categories.

homa.name: HOMA-IR
homa.desc: Estimates insulin resistance from fasting glucose and insulin using the HOMA-IR index.
homa.about: Estimates insulin resistance from fasting glucose and insulin using the HOMA-IR index.

hrzone.name: Heart Rate Zones
hrzone.desc: Derives five Karvonen heart-rate training zones from age and resting heart rate for safe, targeted exercise intensity.
hrzone.about: Derives five Karvonen heart-rate training zones from age and resting heart rate for safe, targeted exercise intensity.

hydrate.name: Daily Water Intake
hydrate.desc: Suggests a daily water-intake range from body weight and activity level for healthy adults.
hydrate.src: Common guideline ≈ 30–35 mL/kg/day for healthy adults
hydrate.about: Suggests a daily water-intake range from body weight and activity level for healthy adults.

ibw.name: Ideal Body Weight
ibw.desc: Estimates ideal body weight from sex and height using the Devine formula. Commonly used for drug dosing and lung-protective ventilator settings.
ibw.about: Estimates ideal body weight from sex and height using the Devine formula. Commonly used for drug dosing and lung-protective ventilator settings.

map.name: Mean Arterial Pressure
map.desc: Calculates mean arterial pressure from systolic and diastolic readings. A key perfusion target in sepsis, shock and critical care, usually kept at 65 mmHg or above.
map.about: Calculates mean arterial pressure from systolic and diastolic readings. A key perfusion target in sepsis, shock and critical care, usually kept at 65 mmHg or above.

meldna.name: MELD-Na Score
meldna.desc: Calculates the MELD-Na score using the 2016 rules to grade end-stage liver disease severity and estimate 3-month mortality; used in transplant prioritization.
meldna.src: Kamath PS et al.; MELD-Na per OPTN 2016 policy
meldna.about: Calculates the MELD-Na score using the 2016 rules to grade end-stage liver disease severity and estimate 3-month mortality; used in transplant prioritization.

fields.label: Dialysis ≥ 2× in the past week (creatinine set to 4.0)

osm.name: Serum Osmolality
osm.desc: Calculates serum osmolality from sodium, glucose and BUN. Comparing it with a measured value reveals an osmolal gap suggesting unmeasured osmoles such as toxic alcohols.
osm.about: Calculates serum osmolality from sodium, glucose and BUN. Comparing it with a measured value reveals an osmolal gap suggesting unmeasured osmoles such as toxic alcohols.

ovul.name: Ovulation & Fertile Window
ovul.desc: Predicts the ovulation day, six-day fertile window and next period from cycle dates — fully supporting Ethiopian calendar input with results shown in both calendars.
ovul.src: Calendar method — ovulation ≈ 14 days before next menses
ovul.about: Predicts the ovulation day, six-day fertile window and next period from cycle dates — fully supporting Ethiopian calendar input with results shown in both calendars.

parkland.name: Parkland Formula
parkland.desc: Calculates 24-hour lactated Ringer's requirements for major burns (4 mL × kg × %TBSA), including catch-up rates when presentation is delayed. Always titrate to urine output.
parkland.about: Calculates 24-hour lactated Ringer's requirements for major burns (4 mL × kg × %TBSA), including catch-up rates when presentation is delayed. Always titrate to urine output.

pedbmi.name: Pediatric BMI
pedbmi.desc: Calculates BMI for children and explains how to interpret it against CDC/WHO age- and sex-specific percentile charts.
pedbmi.src: CDC/WHO — pediatric BMI is age- and sex-percentile based
pedbmi.about: Calculates BMI for children and explains how to interpret it against CDC/WHO age- and sex-specific percentile charts.

peddose.name: Pediatric Dose (mg/kg)
peddose.desc: Calculates per-dose and total daily pediatric drug doses from weight in mg/kg, with an optional maximum single-dose cap.
peddose.about: Calculates per-dose and total daily pediatric drug doses from weight in mg/kg, with an optional maximum single-dose cap.

pedfluid.name: Pediatric Maintenance Fluids
pedfluid.desc: Calculates 24-hour maintenance fluid volume (Holliday–Segar) and the hourly 4-2-1 rate for children by weight.
pedfluid.about: Calculates 24-hour maintenance fluid volume (Holliday–Segar) and the hourly 4-2-1 rate for children by weight.

pedwt.name: Pediatric Estimated Weight
pedwt.desc: Estimates a child's weight from age with APLS formulas for emergencies when a measured weight is unavailable.
pedwt.about: Estimates a child's weight from age with APLS formulas for emergencies when a measured weight is unavailable.

pf.name: PaO₂ / FiO₂ Ratio
pf.desc: Calculates the PaO\u2082/FiO\u2082 oxygenation ratio and assigns Berlin ARDS severity categories.
pf.about: Calculates the PaO\u2082/FiO\u2082 oxygenation ratio and assigns Berlin ARDS severity categories.

pwg.name: Pregnancy Weight-Gain Guide
pwg.desc: Looks up the IOM-recommended total pregnancy weight gain range from pre-pregnancy BMI for singleton pregnancies.
pwg.about: Looks up the IOM-recommended total pregnancy weight gain range from pre-pregnancy BMI for singleton pregnancies.

qsofa.name: qSOFA Score
qsofa.desc: Screens for risk of poor outcome in suspected infection outside the ICU using three quick bedside criteria.
qsofa.src: Singer M et al., Sepsis-3, JAMA 2016
qsofa.about: Screens for risk of poor outcome in suspected infection outside the ICU using three quick bedside criteria.

qtc.name: QTc Calculator
qtc.desc: Corrects the measured QT interval for heart rate using Bazett and Fridericia formulas and flags prolongation and torsades-risk thresholds.
qtc.about: Corrects the measured QT interval for heart rate using Bazett and Fridericia formulas and flags prolongation and torsades-risk thresholds.

ranson.name: Ranson's Criteria
ranson.desc: Applies Ranson's admission and 48-hour criteria to grade acute pancreatitis severity and expected mortality, flagging patients who need intensive care.
ranson.src: Ranson JH et al., Surg Gynecol Obstet 1974
ranson.about: Applies Ranson's admission and 48-hour criteria to grade acute pancreatitis severity and expected mortality, flagging patients who need intensive care.

rcri.name: RCRI — Revised Cardiac Risk Index
rcri.desc: Scores the six Lee index predictors to estimate 30-day risk of major cardiac events after non-cardiac surgery. Guides preoperative cardiology referral and postoperative monitoring.
rcri.src: Lee TH et al., Circulation 1999; risk estimates per Canadian CV Society 2017
rcri.about: Scores the six Lee index predictors to estimate 30-day risk of major cardiac events after non-cardiac surgery. Guides preoperative cardiology referral and postoperative monitoring.

fields.label: High-risk surgery (intraperitoneal, intrathoracic, or suprainguinal vascular)

resomal.name: ReSoMal Rehydration
resomal.desc: Calculates ReSoMal rehydration volumes for dehydrated children with severe acute malnutrition, with monitoring intervals and stop criteria.
resomal.src: WHO management of SAM; Ethiopian SAM guideline (2019)
resomal.about: Calculates ReSoMal rehydration volumes for dehydrated children with severe acute malnutrition, with monitoring intervals and stop criteria.

ron.name: Burn TBSA — Rule of Nines
ron.desc: Estimates the percentage of body surface area burned in adults using the Wallace rule of nines. Feeds directly into burn fluid resuscitation.
ron.about: Estimates the percentage of body surface area burned in adults using the Wallace rule of nines. Feeds directly into burn fluid resuscitation.

rutf.name: RUTF Sachet Dosing (OTP)
rutf.desc: Calculates the outpatient therapeutic RUTF ration — sachets per day and the weekly supply to dispense — from current weight at about 200 kcal/kg/day.
rutf.src: Ethiopian SAM guideline (2019) — OTP; RUTF 92 g ≈ 500 kcal
rutf.about: Calculates the outpatient therapeutic RUTF ration — sachets per day and the weekly supply to dispense — from current weight at about 200 kcal/kg/day.

shock.name: Shock Index
shock.desc: Calculates the shock index (heart rate ÷ systolic BP) to detect occult hemodynamic instability before blood pressure falls.
shock.src: Allgöwer & Burri 1967; SI > 0.9 associated with instability
shock.about: Calculates the shock index (heart rate ÷ systolic BP) to detect occult hemodynamic instability before blood pressure falls.

sofa.name: SOFA Score
sofa.desc: Scores six organ systems to quantify organ failure; an acute rise of 2 or more points with infection defines sepsis under Sepsis-3.
sofa.src: Vincent JL et al., Intensive Care Med 1996; Sepsis-3
sofa.about: Scores six organ systems to quantify organ failure; an acute rise of 2 or more points with infection defines sepsis under Sepsis-3.

tdee.name: Daily Calorie Needs (TDEE)
tdee.desc: Estimates total daily calorie needs by combining Mifflin–St Jeor BMR with an activity factor. Helps set maintenance, deficit or surplus calorie goals.
tdee.about: Estimates total daily calorie needs by combining Mifflin–St Jeor BMR with an activity factor. Helps set maintenance, deficit or surplus calorie goals.

tnm.name: TNM Cancer Staging
tnm.desc: Determines the stage group for 14 common cancers from T, N and M categories — plus PSA and grade for prostate, and FIGO findings for gynecologic cancers — per AJCC 8th edition and FIGO rules, with a plain-language stage meaning.
tnm.src: AJCC Cancer Staging Manual, 8th ed.; FIGO 2018 (cervix)
tnm.about: Determines the stage group for 14 common cancers from T, N and M categories — plus PSA and grade for prostate, and FIGO findings for gynecologic cancers — per AJCC 8th edition and FIGO rules, with a plain-language stage meaning.

tnmcx.name: Cervical Cancer Staging
tnmcx.desc: Stages cervical cancer with the FIGO 2018 system from tumor size, local extension, nodal and metastatic findings, including the TNM equivalents.
tnmcx.about: Stages cervical cancer with the FIGO 2018 system from tumor size, local extension, nodal and metastatic findings, including the TNM equivalents.

wellsdvt.name: Wells Score — DVT
wellsdvt.desc: Applies the Wells criteria to estimate the pre-test probability of deep vein thrombosis and choose between D-dimer and ultrasound pathways.
wellsdvt.about: Applies the Wells criteria to estimate the pre-test probability of deep vein thrombosis and choose between D-dimer and ultrasound pathways.

fields.label: Active cancer (treatment within 6 months, or palliative)
Paralysis, paresis, or recent plaster immobilization of the leg
Recently bedridden ≥ 3 days, or major surgery within 12 weeks
Localized tenderness along the deep venous system
Calf swelling > 3 cm vs asymptomatic side
Pitting edema confined to the symptomatic leg
Alternative diagnosis at least as likely as DVT (−2)

wellspe.name: Wells Score — PE
wellspe.desc: Estimates the pre-test probability of pulmonary embolism and selects D-dimer versus CT pulmonary angiography pathways.
wellspe.src: Wells PS et al., Thromb Haemost 2000
wellspe.about: Estimates the pre-test probability of pulmonary embolism and selects D-dimer versus CT pulmonary angiography pathways.

fields.label: Clinical signs and symptoms of DVT (+3)
PE is the most likely diagnosis (+3)
Immobilization ≥ 3 days or surgery in previous 4 weeks (+1.5)

wound.name: Surgical Wound Classification
wound.desc: Classifies surgical wounds into CDC classes I–IV with typical surgical-site infection risks. Informs antibiotic prophylaxis and wound management decisions.
wound.about: Classifies surgical wounds into CDC classes I–IV with typical surgical-site infection risks. Informs antibiotic prophylaxis and wound management decisions.

wtgain.name: Weight Gain Velocity
wtgain.desc: Tracks nutritional-rehabilitation progress as weight gain in g/kg/day, with poor, moderate and good interpretation bands.
wtgain.src: WHO / Ethiopian SAM guideline — rehabilitation monitoring
wtgain.about: Tracks nutritional-rehabilitation progress as weight gain in g/kg/day, with poor, moderate and good interpretation bands.
